selected.title: The Paguro Journey
selected.description: A travel platform for publishing destination guides, stories, and video-led content in a cleaner, more structured way. Built for independent travelers and travel-focused creators.
selected.longDescription: A content-led travel product designed to organize destination knowledge, storytelling, and editorial publishing into a more coherent user journey.
selected.challenge: Travel content often becomes fragmented across posts, guides, and media, making discovery and structure harder for readers.
selected.solution: The project brings guides, stories, and video content into a cleaner publishing system with more deliberate hierarchy and navigation.
selected.outcome: An in-progress platform with a stronger editorial foundation and clearer direction for travel-focused publishing.

selected.title: Nine2Fire
selected.description: A personal finance and FIRE platform exploring investing, intentional living and the pursuit of greater freedom. Part educational resource, part public experiment documenting the journey along the way.
selected.longDescription: Nine2Fire is a platform exploring financial independence, long-term investing and alternative approaches to work and lifestyle. Combining educational content, practical tools and personal experience, the project aims to make the path toward greater freedom more accessible and more intentional.
selected.challenge: Financial independence, investing and intentional living are often discussed in isolation, making it difficult for people to connect ideas into a practical path they can actually follow.
selected.solution: Nine2Fire brings educational content, personal experiences and practical tools together in one place, creating a more coherent framework for learning and long-term decision making.
selected.outcome: A growing resource that combines knowledge, experimentation and real-world experience to make the journey toward greater freedom more accessible.

selected.title: Recipe Planner
selected.description: A planning interface for organizing recipes, ingredients, and weekly meal decisions with less clutter. Built for people who want a simpler way to plan meals and keep ideas structured.
selected.longDescription: A lightweight planning product centered on making meal organization feel calmer, clearer, and easier to maintain over time.
selected.challenge: Meal planning quickly becomes messy when recipes, ingredients, and weekly decisions are spread across notes and apps.
selected.solution: The interface combines recipe organization and weekly planning into one simpler flow with less visual clutter.
selected.outcome: An early-stage concept focused on clarity, structure, and repeatable weekly planning.
